entities.name: Kimi Räikkönen
entities.description: Kimi-Matias Räikkönen is a Finnish racing and rally driver who competed in Formula One between 2001 and 2021. He won the Formula One World Drivers' Championship in 2007 with Ferrari and won 21 Grands Prix across 19 seasons.
